title: Pitch – Presentation Software
description: Pitch is a clean, professional presentation software page with a distinctive coral-orange brand color that creates immediate visual recognition. The hero section shows a presenter using the product in a real-world context. Feature sections use staggered card layouts with device mockups showing the product interface. Navigation is minimal with a prominent CTA button. Clean sans-serif typography throughout. The page uses subtle scroll animations — cards fade and slide upward as they enter view. The color palette combines deep navy with the signature coral accent for CTAs and highlights.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for B2B SaaS products needing a clean, professional page that showcases product screenshots with prominent feature highlights.
style_vibe: Clean and professional B2B SaaS with a signature coral accent and staggered feature layouts with device mockups.
